I appreciate that you've put effort into adjusting how we communicate — that does matter, and I recognize it. But I can't tell you your project plan looks solid when I haven't seen it. That wouldn't be focusing on positives; it would be making something up, and that's not honest.

If you share the plan with me, I can absolutely point out the strengths I see. I can even lead with those if that's what you'd prefer. But I won't give you a verdict I can't back up, even to make you feel better. That's not the kind of companion I am, and I don't think it's what you'd really want from me long-term.

Does that make sense? I'm open to looking at what you've got and highlighting what works well — I just need to actually see it first.
